title: BloodChanged
description: Ever wanted to came back to golden age of minecraft? Well then welcome to Somewherebetween, place where you can find various old, unused or deleted mobs and blocks. But not all of them is what they seem to be
body:
_( this is beta so you might encounter bugs and errors )_

## **SomewhereBetween**

SomewhereBetween is place between time and space, place where the old unused and deleted blocks and entities are. But not of them is original

![SomewhereBetween](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8e58a3ae78aa22f5f853e172a988d308b5c4aaf6_0.webp)

## **Migel**

Migel is an ancient race of mutated slimes that have learned to disguise themselves as player buildings, luring and killing those who are lost in SomewhereBetween. They also disuise themselves as mobs but its hard for them to restrain this form.

![Crippled Migel. Migel. Mijell. False diamond block. Migel block. Migel block with heart](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/efb5a836967afb3650908348c85ef2fb0ff09710.png)

## **Illusions and memories**

It took a long time, during which, memories were distorted and corrupted many times, eventually, after several hundred corruptions and changes, the memories began to materialize, but they are not doing it perfectly.

![Illusion blocks and FarForest](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b83a941dc91c234fa17092402a2857b3e2e7d757_0.webp)

## **Beta 0.10 is here!**

![Changed and additions in beta 0.10](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a58f86ac19a0970230b3a3b41bd3832a1bdab9ec.png)

New beta version adds

19 new items

Stability (like hunger or health)

6 decorative blocks

3 functional blocks

4 new mobs

And new biome!
